summary: Reconstructs a plane equation from three input points (a2, a3, a4) using SSE intrinsics: forms two edge vectors from the shared point, computes their cross product as the plane normal, normalizes it via fsqrt plus a Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt refinement driven by globals 0x005D8AE0 and 0x005D8AF0, and derives the plane distance D from the dot product of the first point with the normal, sign-flipped via global 0x005D8AD0. Stores the 4-lane plane (Nx, Ny, Nz, D) at output a1 and returns a1. Plane-from-three-points identity rests on the legacy ABI name; no caller is evidenced.

local_names.v18: point A dotted with normal (distance term)

operations.description: Load input point a2 into a vector register via _mm_loadh_ps (high 64 bits); only its two (x, y) lanes take part in the computation.
Form edge vector C - A = loadh(a2) - loadh(a4) (v6).
Form edge vector B - A = loadh(a2) - loadh(a3) (v9).
Cross product of the two edge vectors via shuffle/multiply/subtract (v7, v10, v11, v13) producing the unnormalized plane normal.

Compute squared normal length (lane sums v14, v15), take fsqrt, then Newton-Raphson reciprocal-sqrt refinement using global 0x005D8AE0 (refinement coefficient, described as 0.5 in prior analysis) and global 0x005D8AF0 (normalization scale constant).
Normalize the normal vector: multiply the cross product by the refined reciprocal length (v17).
Store the normalized normal (full 16-byte m128 quad) to the output plane at this+0x0 (RW).
Dot the saved first point (v8 = loadh(a2)) with the normalized normal (v18) and sum the components to obtain the plane distance term.
Negate the distance (sign-flip XOR with global 0x005D8AD0) and store the plane D component into the output plane (lane 3 of the quad, byte offset 0xC).

clean_pseudocode: // a1: output plane (Nx, Ny, Nz, D); a2, a3, a4: three input points
e1 = loadh(a2) - loadh(a4);  // edge from shared point A to point C
e2 = loadh(a2) - loadh(a3);  // edge from shared point A to point B
rlen = refine_rsqrt(dot(n, n)); // fsqrt + Newton step (coeff 0x005D8AE0, scale 0x005D8AF0)
a1 = n * rlen;               // normalized normal; lane 3 overwritten by D
d = -(a2 . a1);               // distance term, sign-flip XOR via 0x005D8AD0
